description: A few checks showing every part of the format. The full sets live in data/checks/.

checks.title: Layer names follow the project's layer naming scheme
checks.why: Consultants filter, freeze and translate layers by name. A layer outside the scheme is invisible to their filters and gets lost on exchange.

fix.note: Put each finding's value (the old layer name) into map with its target layer before running.

checks.title: Every layer in use is listed in the standard
checks.why: Layers missing from the standard have no agreed colour, lineweight or plot setting.

fix.instructions: Add the layer to the standard, or translate its contents to a listed layer.

checks.title: Entities take their colour from the layer
checks.why: Colour overrides break plot styles and make layer changes ineffective.

checks.title: Sheet numbers follow the standard
checks.why: Sheet references, drawing lists and transmittals rely on the numbering scheme.

fix.instructions: Renumber the sheet; update cross-references after.

checks.title: Title blocks have a drawing title
checks.why: A sheet without a title cannot be listed or issued.

checks.title: Text plots at a standard height
checks.why: Odd text heights look careless and can fall below the legible minimum when plotted.

fix.note: Height changes are made by hand or with text.add; this moves the text to the annotation layer.

checks.title: No duplicate lines
checks.why: Overlapping duplicates double plot weight, inflate quantities and confuse edits.

fix.instructions: Delete the duplicate listed in each finding (OVERKILL does this in bulk).

checks.title: The model has few warnings
checks.why: Hundreds of warnings slow the model and hide the few that matter.

fix.instructions: Triage warnings by type and fix the largest groups first.

checks.title: Walls meant to close a room have no open ends
checks.why: Gaps stop rooms and boundaries from closing and give wrong areas.
checks.source: Engine-specific evaluator; reported not_implemented where an engine lacks it
